title: filter: brightness() - Filters - Tailwind CSS
content_text: FILTERS filter: brightness() Utilities for applying brightness filters to an element. Class Styles brightness- filter: brightness(%); brightness-() filter: brightness(var()); brightness-[] filter: brightness(); EXAMPLES Basic example Use utilities like brightness-50 and brightness-100 to control an element's brightness: brightness-50 brightness-100 brightness-125 brightness-200 Using a custom value Use the brightness-[] syntax to set the brightness based on a completely custom value: For CSS variables, you can also use the brightness-() syntax: This is just a shorthand for brightness-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix a filter: brightness() utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above: Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. blur contrast
